metadata.quantityBasis: One craft of each recipe; expected output; normal quality; no productivity bonus.
metadata.interpretation: Shared materials connect producing and consuming recipes across the full network. Return flows preserve recycling and catalysts. Quantities are per craft, not balanced factory throughput.
metadata.upstreamPolicy: Representative non-recycling recipes to external resources; all alternatives are in All products.
